svg.aria-label: wyla end to end: source exports pass an identity gate into nine loaders, become an append-only provenance graph, are compiled by a pure function into an immutable build, which two turn engines read through one reader, streaming a single event log to two web surfaces; the clerk and a blind-graded enricher are the only write paths back into truth.
svg.title: wyla — the whole system, end to end

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: wyla — the whole system, end to end
Source exports become a provenance-typed graph, the graph compiles to an immutable build, two turn engines read that build and only that build, and one event log feeds both surfaces.
L0 · SOURCE EXPORTS — READ-ONLY, NEVER WRITTEN
true recency, not a claimed one
IDENTITY GATE · the crosswalk: 46 human-signed rows. An archive record whose table will not resolve stops the run; a semantic one is skipped with a count.
9 loaders — one module per export shape, not per source meaning
Each emits typed records and nothing else — no arbitration, no policy. Arbitration happens once, later, in the reconciler.
c(sql) pins the SQL dialect in the fingerprint · evidence_ref points at the exact file and row · SQL that will not canonicalize is quarantined by category, never fatally
A utilization ledger accounts for every input file as consumed, deferred(reason), or inventoried — the honest “we hold this and do nothing with it yet.”
16 witness families — only 13 of them may vote
source · run · evidence_ref · status · support · actor · witness
so the bottom of every provenance chain is a file and a row
The graph is compiled, never edited. Where witnesses agree they fold; where they disagree both readings are kept side by side, and the census counts how contested each meaning is.
GRAPH VALIDATOR · 14 pinned checks — grammar, endpoints, relations, duplicates, witnesses, and a certified metric with a home. Any error and nothing compiles.
L3 · THE BUILD — IMMUTABLE ONCE WRITTEN
compile_build() — a pure function: same graph in, byte-identical build out
fold → reconcile (D1–D5) → acl → index rows → cards → census → manifest → diff against the previous build
≤2K tokens of markdown each — the agent's entire world
indexes/ joins · lob · domains · value_meanings · cost_priors
sources · graph_map + census · acl · schema · columns · manifest
The build id is the graph hash — b_<hash12>. No wall clock anywhere inside a build artifact, so a diff in the build is a diff in the data.
COMPILE GATES · table reconciliation · card existence · certified-has-home. All pass ⇒ one atomic CURRENT cutover. Otherwise the promoted build does not move.
nothing below writes to the graph —
the kit has no writer (clerk_only: absent)
L4 · SERVING — READS THE BUILD AND ONLY THE BUILD
the web apps import it from
TURN ENGINE A — THE HARNESS DRIVES
The versioned plan is the state — not the conversation. A grain is
required, so nothing renders without saying what one row means.
An edit moves exactly one slot, computed in code, so “same for
Canada” re-resolves that slot and nothing else.
One ranked blocker ends the turn with a single question whose
options each carry their evidence. Below-margin is a success
Zero model calls on the fast path; at most two — a generator, and
a verifier that never sees the generator's reasoning.
TURN ENGINE B — THE MODEL DRIVES
One interaction per turn, native tool calls, results handed back whole.
12 tools + suggest_next — search · read · sample_values · run_sql ·
propose_sql · python · check · artifact · ask · load_skill · remember · note
checks it runs on itself — part_whole · crosscheck · coverage · fanout ·
reconcile · answer. A passing fact is what lets a composed number
shed its EXPLORATORY watermark; the validator refuses any artifact
budgets: 40 model calls · 600s wall clock · 20K chars per result · 30
messages replayed. A breach ends the turn in plain language.
EXECUTION GATE · pre-hook on every run_sql
cost estimate · scan ceiling · row cap · the build's ACL · dry run first
Both lanes ride it. A gateway plane
behind a short-lived bearer token is
Live execution only where it is
ceiling and a row cap, and only
THE EVENT STREAM — THE ONLY UI TRUTH
meridian.event/1 — one append-only log per turn, read by sequence number
The turn runs in a worker thread and the log is polled rather than called back — thread-safe by construction, and it loses nothing on reconnect.
The events file is the record: a browser coming back mid-turn replays it whole. A turn belongs to the server, not the tab.
SQLite on the laptop, Spanner in
ONE FASTAPI PROCESS · NO BUNDLER · PLAIN ES MODULES
SURFACE 1 · FOR THE PEOPLE WHO STEWARD
table profiles · the cosmos: the graph as
a 3-D sky, positions baked at compile so
a diff in the sky is a diff in the data
Deep links work — a metric profile is a URL.
SURFACE 2 · FOR THE PEOPLE WHO ASK
the chat first, the library under it · tables
are data products · artifacts publish inside
a proposal arrives as a card: Run query ·
Run + build a dashboard · Edit SQL
a deck carries the disclosure in the notes.
browses the semantics, reads the transcripts,
leaves feedback, signs a status change
asks in their own words, taps Run on a
proposal, keeps the artifacts, exports the deck
the only write on the read
to a quad, never one. A
a write back into truth, always witnessed
a gate: it stops the run
a path that deliberately does not exist
